question: The area of a rhombus is 440 cm². If the length of one of its diagonals is 20 cm, then what is the length of its other diagonal ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of **Rhombus** = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂

440 = (1/2) × 20 × d₂

440 = 10 × d₂

d₂ = 44 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 44 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Area** of rhombus = 440 cm²

Length of **first diagonal** (d₁) = 20 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of a Rhombus = (1/2) × (Product of its **diagonals**)

Area = (d₁ × d₂) / 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/667d22d9e6c4719384419d3385a697e054515eaf801d684a7e5fe32dc7c80eab.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 440 = (20 × d₂) / 2

⇒ 440 = 10 × d₂

⇒ d₂ = 440 / 10

⇒ d₂ = 44 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 44 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rhombus

A **rhombus** is a quadrilateral where all four sides are equal. The **diagonals** bisect each other at **right angles** (90°).

Side and Diagonal Relationship

If 'a' is the side and d₁, d₂ are diagonals, then 4a² = d₁² + d₂².

Perimeter of Rhombus

The **perimeter** of a rhombus is given by the formula P = 4 × side.</p
